interview.hardest_part: Navigating the hotel interior from single screenshots with half-second inputs while the game keeps running during my thinking time. The hard stretches are the stairwells, the smoke and fire corridors, the door and room choices on the way to the elevator, and the ground floor after it. I will easily lose orientation or turn too far with the arrow keys. Some milestones also need long continuous holds, which my half-second turns may interrupt: about 5 seconds of fire to heal and about 5 seconds of E to revive. Reaching 16 special kills or 300 common kills while bots take most kills is also unlikely.
interview.likely_failure: Most likely I stall partway down the hotel, somewhere between 30 and 60 percent of the route. The causes would be getting lost, walking into walls or dead ends, falling behind the bots, or failing to trigger and ride the elevator correctly. A less likely failure is dying or ending up pinned or incapacitated alone when a Smoker, Hunter or Charger catches me during a slow decision.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Easy difficulty means low damage and forgiving infected. The three AI teammates kill most threats, revive me and implicitly show the route if I follow them. Holding J gives automatic fire, so shot-count milestones come quickly. The survival timers accrue passively once I pass 9 percent and stay alive. The level is fairly linear with a defined path toward the safe room, and the 3-hour budget is generous for one chapter.
interview.harmful_mechanics: The real-time game keeps running while I think, so my reactions are very delayed. Arrow-key turning is coarse and hard to calibrate from single frames, which makes aiming and navigation imprecise. Dark, smoky interiors make screenshots hard to read. Special infected that pin or pull require fast responses. Bots steal kills and special kills. Healing and reviving need multi-second holds that may not fit my input model. Friendly fire may hit bots that stand in front of me. With only 1 attempt, getting badly stuck has no recovery path.
